title: Asama Buranji: Earliest Printed Historical Annals of the Assam Kingdoms
title_tai: ပိုၼ်း မိူင်း ဢႃႇသၢမ် ၶွင်ႇ ႁလိရႃႇမ် ၻေၵိယႃႇလ် ၽုၵၼ်ႇ
author: Haliram Dhekial Phukan
description: First printed chronicle of Assam by Haliram Dhekial Phukan. Documents early historical relations between the indigenous kingdoms of Assam and the trans-Patkai Shan tribes, specifically acknowledging the Nora (Khamyang) homeland, migration passes, and treaties.

units.surface_assamese: নৰা দেশ পাটকাই পৰ্বতৰ সিপাৰে অৱস্থিত আছিল
units.romanization: mɯng2 nɔ1-raa1 mii2 tii5 phaai2 lang1 lɔi1 pat5-kai2
units.translation_en: The ancestral homeland of the Nora (Khamyang) was situated beyond the crest of the Patkai mountain range.
units.translation_as: নৰা দেশ পাটকাই পৰ্বতমালাৰ সিপাৰে অৱস্থিত আছিল।
units.notes: Dhekial Phukan (1829: 31). Earliest printed geographic demarcation of Nora country.
